description: This file implements request validation and evaluation logic for executing host commands, including security checks, request validation, and policy decision handling.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates an ExecHostRequest, ensuring the command is not empty and resolving it using an external validator, returning a success or failure result.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates the approval decision and security context to determine the policy decision for executing a host request.
